facts.fact: UNICEF's Representative in Mali says a project for a digital platform covering births, deaths and marriages has been approved with UNICEF support since 2022, and the DNEC has selected ten pilot zones.
facts.system: digital civil-status platform for births, deaths and marriages

facts.fact: UNICEF cites a rate of 87% of children under one registered at civil status in Mali, not tied to a digital system.

systems.system: digital civil-status platform for births, deaths and marriages
